headline: Stlican Shelf Narrows to Five-Four; LinnMercy Logs Fresh Strongpoint Changes
war_summary: Since the last edition, Stlican Shelf’s ownership count has moved from six Warden posts and three Colonial posts to five Warden and four Colonial; Thornhold alone accounts for 16 of the region’s 30 recorded strongpoint changes in the past day. LinnMercy, quiet in the afternoon reports, has seen renewed activity, with Lathair drawing 17 changes and the region logging three fresh events in the last two hours. Weathered Expanse remains five Colonial posts to four Warden posts, Frostmarch still the busiest point with 25 events. Fisherman’s Row is all Colonial and yet leads all regions with 41 strongpoint events over 24 hours. Mooring County stands 12 Warden posts; Stonecradle remains 5 Warden to 4 Colonial, with heavy casualties on both ledgers. Callahan’s Passage and the Nevish Line continue heavy attrition without recorded strategic-base changes. Many interior hexes remain quiet; no faction has been declared victor.
